description: Frozen public ranking descriptions with missing Chinese translations; no live services required.

books.title: MISS WOLCOTT'S GHOST
books.author: Louise Penny
books.description: The 21st book in the Chief Inspector Gamache series. Mysteries from the past confound Gamache and his team’s murder investigation.
books.expected_description_zh: 《Chief Inspector Gamache》系列第 21 部。来自过去的谜团让加马什（Gamache）及其团队的谋杀案调查陷入困境。

books.title: A MARRIED LITTLE CHRISTMAS
books.author: Abby Jimenez
books.description: A collection of three holiday novellas: “Sweater Weather,” “Stealing Christmas” and “Marry Little Christmas.”
books.expected_description_zh: 收录三篇节日主题中篇小说：《Sweater Weather》《Stealing Christmas》和《Marry Little Christmas》。

books.title: THE FAMILY CROSS
books.author: James Patterson
books.description: The 36th book in the Alex Cross series. A family crisis and the D.C. underworld put the psychologist in a tight spot.
books.expected_description_zh: 《Alex Cross》系列第 36 部。家庭危机与华盛顿特区的地下犯罪势力让这位心理学家陷入困境。

books.title: CHAIN REACTION
books.author: Lee Child and Andrew Child
books.description: The 31st book in the Jack Reacher series. Gen. Susan Turner needs Reacher’s help to solve the murder of a team member on covert duty.
books.expected_description_zh: 《Jack Reacher》系列第 31 部。苏珊·特纳（Susan Turner）将军需要里奇（Reacher）的帮助，调查一名执行秘密任务的团队成员遇害一案。

books.title: WITH HEARTS OF FLAME
books.author: Briar Boleyn
books.description: The fourth book in the Bloodwing Academy series. A secret dwarven quest, the presence of dragons and an ancient prophecy may force sacrifices to be made.
books.expected_description_zh: 《Bloodwing Academy》系列第 4 部。矮人的秘密任务、龙的出现和一则古老预言，可能迫使人们作出牺牲。

books.title: MERCY'S CHILD
books.author: Richard Paul Evans
books.description: In 1874, Etta Wheeler moves to New York City, where she winds up fighting some powerful institutions.
books.expected_description_zh: 1874 年，埃塔·惠勒（Etta Wheeler）搬到纽约市，最终与一些权势强大的机构展开抗争。

books.title: CHRISTMAS STAYCATION
books.author: Meghan Quinn
books.description: The third book in the How My Neighbor Stole Christmas series. Taran is caught between brothers this holiday season.
books.expected_description_zh: 《How My Neighbor Stole Christmas》系列第 3 部。这个假日季，塔兰（Taran）陷入一对兄弟之间的纠葛。

books.title: CROWNED BY ROSES
books.author: Elizabeth Helen
books.description: The seventh book in the Beasts of the Briar series. Disparate forces must join together for one final fight.
books.expected_description_zh: 《Beasts of the Briar》系列第 7 部。各方势力必须携手，进行最后一战。

books.title: ANDY'S BRAVO SCRAPBOOK
books.author: Andy Cohen
books.description: The Emmy Award–winning host shares recollections and photographs from reality TV over two decades.
books.expected_description_zh: 这位艾美奖获奖主持人分享二十多年来真人秀节目中的回忆与照片。

books.title: WTF AMERICA?!
books.author: Ben Meiselas, Brett Meiselas and Jordy Meiselas
books.description: The founders of the independent news network MeidasTouch give their take on our current political and social climate.
books.expected_description_zh: 独立新闻网络 MeidasTouch 的创办人阐述他们对美国当下政治与社会状况的看法。

books.title: AMERICA'S GOLDEN AGE
books.author: Newt Gingrich
books.description: The former speaker of the House prognosticates about the future of our country based on developments in technology and the actions of President Trump.
books.expected_description_zh: 这位前美国众议院议长根据科技发展和特朗普总统的行动，对美国的未来作出预测。

books.title: UNELECTED
books.author: Jennica Pounds and Joshua Lisec
books.description: A data analyst blames non-governmental organizations for the current state of our economy.
books.expected_description_zh: 一位数据分析师将美国当前的经济状况归咎于非政府组织。

books.title: WHY FAUCI MUST ROT IN PRISON
books.author: Peter Navarro
books.description: The senior counselor and assistant to the president in the Trump White House assesses the work of the former chief medical adviser to the president.
books.expected_description_zh: 特朗普白宫的总统高级顾问兼助理评述已卸任的总统首席医疗顾问的工作。

books.title: DRAGONBORN: THE TWILIGHT CHILD
books.author: Struan Murray
books.description: In this sequel to “Dragonborn,” Alex and her friends undertake a perilous journey to stop Drak Midna’s plot to kill all humans. (Ages 8 to 12)
books.expected_description_zh: 在《Dragonborn》的这部续集中，亚历克斯（Alex）与朋友们踏上危险旅程，阻止德拉克·米德纳（Drak Midna）杀光所有人类的阴谋。（适读年龄：8 至 12 岁）

books.title: LICORICE
books.author: Kara LaReau
books.description: Kitty feels like she's living in the shadow of Max's former cat, Licorice. (Ages 8 to 12)
books.expected_description_zh: 基蒂（Kitty）觉得自己活在马克斯（Max）以前养的猫利科里斯（Licorice）的阴影中。（适读年龄：8 至 12 岁）

books.title: EVERYTHING'S NOT LOST
books.author: Frederick Joseph
books.description: Sixteen-year-old Ella Washington deals with mental illness, grief and bullying. (Ages 14 and up)
books.expected_description_zh: 16 岁的埃拉·华盛顿（Ella Washington）应对精神疾病、悲伤与霸凌。（适读年龄：14 岁及以上）
